name: UTF-8 vs UTF-16 Byte Calculator
description: Compare UTF-8 and UTF-16 encoded byte sizes for text, including Unicode characters and emoji.
search_intent: Calculate how many bytes a string uses in UTF-8 versus UTF-16 encoding.
calculation: Calculate UTF-8 encoded length using TextEncoder or an equivalent standards-correct implementation. Calculate UTF-16 storage as JavaScript UTF-16 code units × 2 bytes, excluding an optional byte-order mark unless explicitly stated. Separately count Unicode code points so surrogate-pair characters such as emoji are handled transparently. Difference = UTF-8 bytes - UTF-16 bytes. Report equal when sizes match.
limitations: UTF-16 byte counts exclude a byte-order mark unless explicitly stated.
Unicode code points are not the same as user-perceived grapheme clusters.
File formats and protocols may add additional metadata beyond encoded text bytes.
